title: Lien for pilotage fees.
bodyText: Every licensed pilot shall have a lien for the pilot's pilotage fees upon the whole of any vessel liable to the pilot therefor.
bodyHtml: §462A-14  Lien for pilotage fees.  Every licensed pilot shall have a lien for the pilot's pilotage fees upon the whole of any vessel liable to the pilot therefor. [L 1978, c 231, pt of §2; gen ch 1985]
